# 2KnowMySelf

> > Self-help and personal development resource covering psychology, goal setting, career guidance, and personal growth strategies.

2KnowMySelf is a personal development platform founded by M.Farouk Radwan, offering practical psychology-based advice on life challenges, career development, time management, and emotional well-being. The site provides actionable guidance for self-improvement and overcoming personal obstacles.

## Key Topics

- Self-help
- Personal development
- Psychology
- Goal setting
- Time management
- Career guidance
- Job interviews
- Depression and mood
- Behavioral change
- Life coaching
- Productivity
- Entrepreneurship
- Learning from failure
- Personal responsibility
- M.Farouk Radwan

## Core Self-Help Articles

- [I need help with my life](https://2knowmyself.com/depression/i_need_help_with_my_life): Self-help article on personal responsibility and overcoming life problems
- [I cannot help myself](https://2knowmyself.com/I_cannot_help_myself): Article on mood improvement through small actions and behavioral change
- [How your failures can help you succeed](https://2knowmyself.com/how_your_failures_can_help_you_succeed): M.Farouk Radwan on learning from failures in entrepreneurship and startups

## Goal Setting & Career Development

- [Goal setting and time management](https://2knowmyself.com/directory/42): Category directory for goal setting, time management, and productivity articles
- [Answers to common interview questions](https://2knowmyself.com/help_finding_a_job/answers_to_common_interview_questions): Guide to answering common job interview questions and preparation tips

## Article Directory

- [Self help and personal development articles](https://2knowmyself.com/self_help_and_personal_development_articles_3): Article directory for self-help, psychology, and personal development topics
